intro: One plate of nasi goreng kampung has about 600 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice and cooking oil.
diet: Yes, but don't make it your daily meal. Shop fried rice usually uses more oil and a big portion of rice. Having it once in a while is okay, just balance it with lighter meals that day. Add protein so you stay full longer.
tips: Ask for 'kurang minyak' when you order. Most shops can do it.
Add a boiled egg or ayam bakar instead of ayam goreng.
Ask for extra vegetables, and share or leave some rice if the portion is big.

swap.name: 1 cup white rice + ikan bakar + vegetables
swap.why: Less oil, more protein, and you still get your rice.

faq.q: What's the difference between nasi goreng kampung and normal nasi goreng?
faq.a: Nasi goreng kampung has ikan bilis, chilli and usually kangkung. It's spicier and smells of sambal.

faq.q: Can I cook nasi goreng kampung with less oil?
faq.a: Yes. Use a non-stick pan and 1 teaspoon of oil. Fry the ikan bilis with just a little oil.

faq.q: Is nasi goreng okay for breakfast?
faq.a: Sure, lots of Malaysians eat nasi goreng in the morning. Just take a smaller portion if you're having rice again for lunch.
